papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常在錯誤答案上表現出高度自信。標準校準方法通常全局或在分數層面運作，雖然減少不合理的自信，但也可能侵蝕正確答案的合理自信。本文提出 Probe-Conditioned Head Intervention (PCHI)，一種推理時方法：使用凍結的探針檢測可能錯誤但自信的回應，並在生成信心時條件性地重新縮放下游注意力頭輸出。該方法能在降低過度自信的同時保留甚至提升對正確答案的信心。

links.title: SaliMory: Orchestrating Cognitive Memory for Conversational Agents

primary_link.title: POLARIS: Guiding Small Models to Write Long Stories

radar.title: DAR: Deontic Reasoning with Agentic Harnesses
radar.title_zh: DAR：基於代理人束的義務推理

links.title: SharedRequest: Privacy-Preserving Model-Agnostic Inference for Large Language Models

primary_link.title: SharedRequest: Privacy-Preserving Model-Agnostic Inference for Large Language Models

radar.title: SharedRequest: Privacy-Preserving Model-Agnostic Inference for Large Language Models
radar.title_zh: SharedRequest：大型語言模型的隱私保護模型無關推論

links.title: Optimizing the Cost-Quality Tradeoff of Agentic Theorem Provers in Lean

radar.title_zh: 在 Lean 中優化代理人定理證明的成本-品質權衡

links.title: R-APS: Compositional Reasoning and In-Context Meta-Learning for Constrained Design via Reflective Adversarial Pareto Search

radar.title_zh: 邊學邊做：面向線上終身學習代理人的技能增強測試時共演化框架

radar.title_zh: LifeSide：評估作為終身數位伴侶的代理人
